_description: Fleet box whose distinguishing duty is the cloud snapshot push (a systemd timer, not a gateway.json setting). Gateway side is the minimal useful shape: MQTT RX + RNS bridge with a single operator LXMF destination. No mesh_bridge, no peer-gateway relay.
_usage: cp cloud-publisher.json ~/.config/meshforge/gateway.json && edit every <PLACEHOLDER>. Pair with the 'cloud-publisher' fleet role (enables meshforge-cloud-push.timer). Then: sudo systemctl restart meshforge-gateway
